title: Process Improvement Department Builder - Contract 4-6 Months
description:
Process Improvement Department Builder Contract (4-6 months) • Build it, staff it, hand it off 
 Location: India, remote (occasional travel) • Overlap: partial overlap with US Eastern business hours • Engagement: contract / consulting, 4 to 6 months, with a defined exit 
 The situation We are a ~200-person US medical-services company with operations in the USA, South America and India. For 30 years, one person has been the only source of process design and improvement. 
 Our process-improvement team today is two Senior Business Analysts. That's it. No structure, no process, no method of work, no tools, no management layer. We want someone who has built a process-improvement department from scratch before to build ours and then leave it running without them. 
 The engagement Weeks 12: Deliver a phased plan from where we are to where we need to be — OKRs, milestones, realistic timelines. Months 1–2: Build the department: method of work, standards, best practices, tools. Take our first process (FES) through discovery and standardization. Months 2–4: Recruit and install the department's permanent manager. Put the management structure in place. Bring the first process under control. Months 4–6: The manager runs the department. You hand off and exit. Your exit is planned from Day 1. Success is a department that runs without you. 
 What you'll do Build the department's execution processes — how work is identified, prioritized, designed, approved and controlled. Instill proven best practices and choose the department's own tools (process mapping, tracking, measurement). Take processes up the maturity ladder: discover standardize control optimize automate. (Our Fractional CTO owns automation technology; you lead the process to that point.) Build the measurement system — baselines, KPIs, dashboards — where little data exists today. Gather requirements and author Business Cases (problem root cause options ROI recommendation). Mentor the two Senior BAs, hire the team, and recruit the permanent manager who takes over from you. Work at the strategic "what and why" level — and roll up your sleeves to do analyst work yourself when needed. 
 You must have Built a process-improvement / process-excellence department or function from scratch , and handed it to a manager who kept it running. Personally hired a team you owned (5+ hires). Authored Business Cases that were approved. A strong data perspective on process work — you've built measurement systems, not just used them. Comfort starting with almost nothing: two BAs, no structure, no playbook. 
 A plus (not required) Healthcare, revenue-cycle or insurance-claims experience. Lean / Six Sigma / BPM methodology. Experience working across countries. 
 This is not for you if You advise and hand the building to someone else. Your team experience is training or certifying people rather than hiring and running a team. You need clean data, a team or a playbook before you can start. You're looking for a permanent role or a technology-strategy role. 
 How to apply — answer every question Type BUILDER as the first word of your reply. Have you personally built a process-improvement / process-excellence department from scratch (not joined an existing one)? Yes / No. Name the company and the team size when you started and when you left. After you left, did a manager you put in place keep running it ? Yes / No. May we speak with that person? Yes / No. How many people have you personally hired into a team you owned? (number) How many Business Cases (problem root cause options ROI recommendation) have you personally authored that were approved , in the last 3 years? (number) Have you built a process measurement system (baselines, KPIs, dashboards)? Yes / No. Which tools? Are you open to a 4–6 month contract with a defined exit — build the department, hire its manager, hand it off? Yes / No. We have two Senior BAs and no structure. Will you personally do analyst-level work from Day 1? Yes / No. Your expected monthly fee , your earliest start date , and how many hours of US Eastern overlap you can offer. 
 Finalists complete a short paid planning assignment before any contract. We speak with the manager who took over your last department.

title: AGM/DGM - MEP Execution
description:
WE ARE HIRING 
 Role: Package Manager (MEP) 
 Designation: AGM/DGM 
 Job Profile 
 Responsible for the overall management, coordination, and execution of electrical systems within the 
 project. The role encompasses all post-tender activities, from construction to project handover and 
 closure of the Defects Liability Period. 
 Key responsibilities: 
 Supervise and monitor MEP (Electrical) contractors and subcontractors on-site to ensure 
 adherence to project specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements. 
 Track and report on project progress against the master plan; coordinate with the Planning 
 Department to update schedules and develop recovery plans in case of delays. 
 ¢ Maintain proper documentation of project progress and delays through formal communication, 
 including letters useful for contractual and dispute resolution purposes. 
 ¢ Coordinate effectively among various contractors, subcontractors, and internal departments to 
 ensure smooth execution of project phases. 
 ¢ Review resource utilization reports (e.g., manpower histograms, equipment schedules) and assess 
 adequacy for timely project delivery. 
 ¢ Review and approve monthly contractor bills and verify work progress. 
 ¢ Evaluate variation requests; coordinate with the Procurement team to ensure appropriate and 
 timely actions. 
 ¢ Liaise with local authorities, utility providers, and municipality departments to obtain necessary 
 approvals and connections. 
 ¢ Collaborate with the Facilities Management team to ensure a seamless transition from contractor 
 maintenance to internal maintenance operations. 
 ¢ Ensure the contractor submits and updates the following key documents: 
 ¢ Shop Drawings, Material Submittals, and Method Statements 
 ¢ As-Built Drawings 
 ¢ Testing & Commissioning Procedures 
 ¢ Operation & Maintenance Manuals 
 ¢ Handover Documentation 
 ¢ Organize and facilitate training sessions for in-house FM teams on various systems prior to 
 handover. 
 ¢ Enforce project-specific QA/QC procedures in accordance with the Project Quality Manual. 
 ¢ Conduct site inspections to verify quality and workmanship of installations. 
 
 
 
 ¢ Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for deviations from project specifications or industry 
 standards. 
 ¢ Witness 1st fix, 2nd fix, and final fix stages of installations, as well as testing and commissioning 
 of all electrical systems. 
 ¢ Respond to RFIs (Requests for Information) from contractors in a timely and accurate manner. 
 ¢ Coordinate with the in-house Design Management team to resolve project-related electrical 
 issues. Stay current with and ensure compliance to International and Local Building Codes and 
 Standards. 
 Technical Expertise 
 ¢ Must have hands-on experience in the procurement, installation, and testing & commissioning of 
 the following systems: 
 ¢ Electrical Distribution Systems, Emergency Power Supply, Lighting & Small Power, Earthing and 
 Lightning Protection 
 ¢ Fire Detection and Alarm Systems, Access Control and Security Systems 
 ¢ Data, Telephone, and Communication Networks 
 ¢ Building Management Systems (BMS) and Home Automation 
 ¢ Vertical Transportation Systems (Lifts, Escalators) and Conveyor Systems 
 Qualification: 
 Education: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech. 
 Experience: 15 years in real estate development or construction, with a strong background in 
 electrical systems and project execution 
 Preferred. Skills: 
 Comprehensive knowledge of installation and T&C of all electrical systems in building and 
 infrastructure projects 
 Exposure to design and/or maintenance is advantageous 
 Strong coordination, communication, and interpersonal skills 
 Familiarity with different construction methodologies and system integration approaches
